description: This Java source file defines a utility class `UiUtils` containing static methods for GUI-related functionalities such as saving images, capturing screenshots, adjusting button labels, centering windows, repainting components, and creating GUI controls like buttons and file choosers. It provides support for image handling, dialog prompts, tooltip formatting, and UI element manipulation, primarily used within the `com.rusefi.ui.util` package.

classes.name: UiUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for various UI operations such as image handling, control updates, and dialog interactions within the `com.rusefi.ui.util` package.

methods.name: saveImageWithPrompt
methods.description: Prompts the user with a file chooser to specify the filename for saving an image, then saves the provided component content as a PNG file.

methods.name: getFileChooser
methods.description: Creates and returns a configured JFileChooser with the specified file filter.

methods.name: saveImage
methods.description: Captures a screenshot of a component and saves it as a PNG image to the specified filename.

methods.name: getScreenShot
methods.description: Generates a BufferedImage representing the visual content of the given component.

methods.name: setPauseButtonText
methods.description: Sets the text of a pause/resume button depending on the paused state.

methods.name: centerWindow
methods.description: Centers a window on the screen.

methods.name: trueRepaint
methods.description: Forces a control (JComponent or Container) to invalidate, validate, and repaint to refresh its display.

methods.name: trueLayout
methods.description: Invalidates, validates, and repaints a component to update its layout.

methods.name: setTwoLineToolTip
methods.description: Sets a tooltip on a JComponent with two lines of text formatted in HTML.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Wraps a JComponent inside a JPanel.

methods.name: createSaveImageButton
methods.description: Creates a JButton configured for saving images with a mnemonic.

methods.name: loadIcon
methods.description: Loads an ImageIcon from a resource path relative to the StartupFrame class.

methods.name: invokeAndWait
methods.description: Executes a Runnable on the Event Dispatch Thread, waiting for completion.

methods.name: showLoadingMessage
methods.description: Adds a 'Loading...' label to a panel to indicate progress.

methods.name: createPauseButton
methods.description: Creates a JButton for pause/resume functionality with a mnemonic.

methods.name: createClearButton
methods.description: Creates a JButton for clearing the display with a mnemonic.
